summary: Frontend-only test of VALEO planteur-loan isolation bug fix. Verified via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844). PLANTEUR flow: LoanSheet now displays a read-only card with the connected planteur (nom, village, code PL-...) instead of a Select dropdown; the loan request is correctly saved and appears in 'Mes prêts' attributed to the connected planteur. ISOLATION: planteur nav only exposes 'Mes poids' + FAB + 'Mobile Money' — no 'Planteurs' tab, no listing of other members. PATRON non-regression: LoanSheet still shows a Select for 'Planteur bénéficiaire' (chevron + 'Nom — Village' pattern) and options include both existing planteurs (Kouassi Yao Test and Alice Test Planteur). No red screen, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx L290 correctly renders <LoanSheet fixedMember={me}/> only for session.side==='planteur' and enforces memberId=session.memberId on save, so a spread cannot overwrite it. L291 renders LoanSheet without fixedMember for coop/patron — Select is preserved. sheets.tsx L219-266 handles the fixedMember prop cleanly: read-only card is rendered inside a Field, no Select is mounted, and onSave forces memberId=fixedMember?.id||memberId.
PlanteurPrets, PlanteurPoids and PlanteurMomo already filter by member.id, and the planteur NavBar exposes no 'Planteurs' route — isolation is enforced both at data and navigation levels.
seed_data_creation: Created a test planteur 'Alice Test Planteur' (PL-2026-0002, Sikensi, PIN 1111) via the Créer un compte planteur flow, then created a 25 000 F Intrant loan request (motif: Engrais NPK). Patron 'Diomande Mamadou' (COOPTEST, 0700000001, PIN 1234) already existed in the preview store along with 'Kouassi Yao Test' (PL-2026-0001) and prior collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Expo web served at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. State is persisted via AsyncStorage (localStorage). Use mobile viewport 390x844. To reach LoanSheet as planteur: login/create planteur -> tap FAB (data-testid='fab'). Verify no 'Nom — Village' Select label appears (that's the Select rendering pattern) and that a read-only card with '<village> · PL-YYYY-XXXX' is present. To reach LoanSheet as patron: login as patron -> nav-coop -> 'Demandes de prêt' -> 'Nouveau prêt / créance'.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (already fixed by main agent): planteur session was rendering the same LoanSheet as patron, which included a Select over data.members allowing the planteur to pick a different beneficiary; addLoan then persisted whatever memberId the sheet had. Fix: introduced a `fixedMember` prop that (1) replaces the Select with a read-only member card and (2) forces memberId=fixedMember.id on save; index.tsx only renders that variant for session.side==='planteur', and additionally overrides memberId=session.memberId in the save handler so the spread order cannot leak another id. Verified end-to-end via UI.
